description.mn: Acqua di Parma Colonia Quercia: Эрэгтэйчүүдэд зориулсан цитрус үнэр (Cologne). Эхний ноот: бергамот, нимбэг, петигрейн, ягаан чинжүү.
description.en: Colonia Quercia, crafted by Acqua di Parma, is an amber-spicy fragrance designed for men. Introduced in 2016, this scent opens with lively top notes of Bergamot, Lemon, Petitgrain, and Pink Pepper. The heart reveals a captivating blend of Geranium, Cedar, and Cardamom, while the base features deep, earthy notes of Oakmoss, Tonka Bean, and Patchouli.
